$comment: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER PENDING GAME DESIGN.
Power, range, radius, cooldowns and projectile speeds are NOT design decisions; they
exist only so the Core v3 vertical slice can run. Design owns every value here.
Abilities, protocol 3 form (ADR-30): a delivery and an ordered effect list.
effects[].kind: damage (power) | heal (power) | apply_status (statusId, see statuses.json).
projectile delivery needs a projectile block: speed (units/s), radius, range (units).
cooldownTicks is BASE SIMULATION TICKS (60 per second at the default critical rate).
Ground and projectile deliveries affect entities of a different type than the caster
(placeholder hostility rule pending a faction design).
Ability 1 is an entity-targeted damage ability because Netcode's live tests
(GameplayV2LiveTests.BoltAbility) cast id 1 at an entity; keep that id stable.
